analysis: The only change in this PR is a single documentation row added at docs/architecture/inference.md line 1389. It describes the `decodeStepsBetweenPrefillChunks` scheduler setting: 4 for the Qwen 3.5 family (`Qwen35Model`, including `Qwen35MoEModel`) and 0 otherwise, with the code pointer `EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift` (`qwenDecodeStepsBetweenPrefillChunks`). No source code, wire protocol, cryptography, attestation, authorization, cache-storage or key-handling behavior changes in the supplied evidence. I examined both head-text units (lines 1216-2045) for surrounding context. The setting interleaves decode-only steps between prompt chunks. That is a scheduling latency/availability parameter and touches none of the T-041 cache scope, HMAC naming, TTL or encryption controls. It is also consistent with the existing Deadlines text about the engine replaying decode-only steps between prompt chunks (lines 1469-1473), which already references this setting. The existing T-010 and T-029 DoS concerns (cancellation, GPU monopolization) are not shown to be affected. The doc claims a code default, but the implementing source was not supplied, so the actual Qwen default value (4) and its interaction with deadline admission projection and the prefill-chunk/stripe geometry are unverified here. A documentation-accuracy check against `EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift` is the only integration follow-up. No security regression or threat-model gap was identified.
